original_target.title: Null control of a singular two-dimensional Grushin heat equation
original_target.area: Inverse problems, control and parabolic PDEs

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original requires null control of the two-dimensional interior-singular Grushin transmitting self-adjoint realization, arbitrary gamma,nu,geometry,time, including one-sided strip and nonzero inverse-square potential. Lissy–Lourme current v2 proves one-dimensional heat null control and explicitly leaves the singular2D Grushin problem in §5. Vanlaere treats2D boundary or higher-dimensional interior singularities; these do not establish the complete original classification. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
